findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Inspector observed employees donning gloves without handwashing. Education was carried out. The behavior was abolished. Ensure that staff remember to wash their hands before donning gloves at all times.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (A) After touching bare human body parts other than clean hands and clean, exposed portions of arms; (B) After using the toilet room; (C) After caring for or handling SERVICE ANIMALS or aquatic animals as specified in 2-403.11(B); (D) Except as specified in 2-401.11(B), after coughing, sneezing, using a handkerchief or disposable tissue, using TOBACCO PRODUCTS, eating, or drinking; (E) After handling soiled EQUIPMENT or UTENSILS; (F) During FOOD preparation, as often as necessary to remove soil and contamination and to prevent cross contamination when changing tasks; (G) When switching between working with raw FOOD and working with READY-TO-EAT FOOD; (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD; and (I) After engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The coving on the wall left of the hot box at the entrance of the cook line was observed coming off the wall. PIC was made aware. PIC assured inspector that the coving will be sealed to the wall properly. Ensure that the coving is sealed the wall properly providing a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: An employee phone was observed on the prep table in the back prep area. PIC was made aware. The phone was removed and education was carried out. Ensure that employees are aware not to place their phones or any item (s) that could contaminate food during prep or storage.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(3) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (3) Cleaning equipment and utensils as specified under 4-602.11(A) and sanitizing as specified under § 4-703.11.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The nozzles on the soda machine were observed soiled. Education was carried out. The nozzles were removed and scrubbed. Inspector reexamined the nozzles and they showed evidence of being cleaned and sanitized. Ensure that food contact surfaces such as the soda nozzles are monitored, cleaned, and sanitized at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties
findings.comment:
2-101.11: At the start of the inspection, there was no designated PIC and no one in the facility was present in the facility with an active CFM. When the permit holder is the PIC and is not present in the facility, a designated PIC must be present in the facility with an active CFM. The permit holder/PIC was present by the end of the inspection with an active CFM. Ensure a designated PIC with an active CFM is available during all hours of operation. This violation was observed during the previous routine inspection on 1/9/2024 and the facility will receive a Warning Notice to document the violation. 
2-101.11: (A) PERMIT HOLDER shall be PIC or shall designate PIC and ensure the PIC is present during all hours of operation. (B) FOOD ESTABLISHMENT with multiple departments on same PREMISES can designate single PIC when food is not being prepared.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: At the start of the inspection, no CFM was present in the facility. Being a High Risk establishment, a CFM must be present during all hours of operation. The owner of the facility became present during the inspection and has a valid CFM. This violation was observed during the routine inspection on 1/9/2024 and the facility will be receiving a Warning Notice to document this violation. 
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: The hood system above the cook-line is observed to have an accumulation of grease that has formed drips. This surface needs to be cleaned to remove the current build-up of grease. A follow-up will take place on Monday, June 3, 2024 to observe this surface clean and free of drips. This is a repeat violation from the 1/9/2024 routine inspection and the facility will be receiving a Warning Notice to document this violation. 
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: There was observed peppers stored directly next to raw shrimp in the meat prep cooler. The peppers were moved to the top shelf to allow proper storage. Ensure teat food items are properly stored to prevent cross contamination during storage. 
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-602.11: The ice machine is observed to have an accumulation of mold/soil on the ice baffle. PIC was made aware of this build-up and will be cleaning and sanitizing its surface. Ensure the ice baffle surface is observed, cleaned, and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain it clean. A follow-up will take place on 06/03/2024 to observe the correction to this violation. This is a repeat violation from the 1/9/24 inspection and the facility will receive a Warning Notice to document the violation. 
4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The utensil drawer along the prep station is observed to have a significant amount of soil/debris in the bottom of the drawers and on the walls of the drawers. All items in this container will need to be washed, rinsed, and sanitized. The drawers will need to also be washed rinsed and sanitized before storing the utensils inside of them. These drawers and utensils will be observed during the 06/03/24 follow-up.
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The following areas were observed unclean to sight/touch:
-The ice scoop was observed stored in a bucket with water int he bottom with a dead fly in the water. 
-The soda nozzles at the dispenser were observed with an accumulation of mold/soil. 
Ensure these surfaces are washed, rinsed, and sanitized to remove the current soils and then cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: There were two sanitizer buckets in the facility which tested around 10ppm Chlorine. These buckets had bleach added to them and were retested at 200ppm Chlorine. Ensure that test strips are used at regular intervals and that sanitizer buckets are changed out at a frequency necessary to maintain the sanitizer’s efficacy. 
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
7-201.11: Observed above the prep table in the kitchen was a pan that contained stored oracle and other personal items. These items were removed from this location. Ensure personal items are stored in a manner that does not pose a contamination hazard. This is a repeat violation from the 1/9/24 inspection and the facility will receive a Warning Notice to document the violation. 
7-201.11: (A)-(B) POISONOUS MATERIALS shall be stored to prevent contamination of FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES by separating or locating MATERIALS in area away or below FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES (use partition or store below).

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
3-307.11: The single service containers were observed facing up with the food contact surface exposed to the ambient environment. These single service items were inverted during the inspection. Ensure that single service items are protected from contamination to the food contact surface during storage, preparation, and display. 
3-307.11: FOOD shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301-3-306.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-501.11: The front of the ice machine is observed to have peeling/cracking covering material. This material needs to be removed. Ensure this material is removed to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface. 
4-501.11: (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in good repair. (B) EQUIPMENT components shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted to manufacturer’s specifications. (C) Cutting or piercing parts of can opens shall be kept sharp to minimize metal fragmentation.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: The bottom of the meat prep cooler is observed to have an accumulation of water, most likely from condensation. Ensure the food items present remain contained in their containers and are removed nightly to clean the bottom of the cooler of any excess water accumulation. This violation was observed during the original inspection conducted on 8/14/2023 and 1/9/2024. A Notice to Correct will be sent to the facility regarding this violation. 
4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The following locations were observed to have an accumulation of food soil/debris and need to be cleaned and sanitized:
-The shelf above the ice cream machine.
Ensure these surfaces are cleaned and sanitized to remove the current build-up of debris and then cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. This violation was observed on the 1/9/24 routine inspection and the facility will receive a Warning Notice to document the violation. 
4-601.11:(B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The following areas were observed in a state of disrepair:
-The door to the ice machine top is observed to not be attached to the machine.
-The gasket of the left door of the meat prep cooler is in a state of disrepair. 
Ensure these areas are repaired to create smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surfaces that also helps he machinery function properly. 
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: The wall to the right of the hand sink is osberved to have a visible gap where it connects at the corner. Ensure repairs are made to this area to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface. 
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The air vents in the facility attached to the ceiling are observed to have an accumulation of dust/debris present on and around them. Ensure that the dust/debris is cleaned to remove the current accumulation a then cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
6-303.11: There is observed a lightbulb out in the hood system. Ensure this lightbulb is replaced to meet manufacturer’s recommended output of light. 
6-303.11: The light intensity shall be at least a certain lux and present in certain areas.
